name: nthview
description: Learn anything, in the nth view that suits you. Skills that turn any concept, paper or codebase into one shareable, single-file HTML view: a scenario quiz, an island game, an explorable lab, a detective case, a concept map, a zoomable code map or a courier planet, or a multi-chapter lesson that mixes them. Works on any machine; Node, Bun or Deno recommended for the validators and build tools, not required.
